tasks.gr9-advertising-visual-design-t1: Topic: Advertising and visual design. Cover AIDA (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action), emotive language, tone, target audience, and persuasive techniques. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify persuasive techniques, analyse visual and verbal choices, explain tone shifts, match advertising strategies to audience needs, and justify how design influences readers.
tasks.gr9-essay-transactional-writing-t1: Topic: Essay and transactional writing. Cover narrative, descriptive, reflective, and argumentative essay types; poster copy; process writing; audience and purpose. Ask Grade 9 learners to identify essay types, plan essays with suitable forms, craft transactional responses for purpose and audience, match audience-purpose in writing choices, and apply process writing (plan, draft, review, revise).
tasks.gr9-grammar-revision-accuracy-t1: Topic: Grammar revision and accuracy. Cover nouns, adjectives, verbs, spelling, punctuation, direct and indirect speech. Ask Grade 9 learners to consolidate prior grammar, edit passages for errors, convert between direct and indirect speech, identify and correct punctuation mistakes, and explain how grammar choices improve writing clarity.
